sec14-sharing-the-road

FACT_ID: sec14-R01 | anchor: A02
A driver passing a person on a bicycle must leave at least three feet of space beside that rider [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint vulnerable-user-clearance; prereq_hint [basic lane position]; difficulty_hint 1; confusable_with [sec14-R06].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0084]

FACT_ID: sec14-R02 | anchor: A01
Deliberately distracting a vulnerable road user in order to threaten harm or push that person off the road can lead to a citation with points on the driving record [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint vulnerable-user-protection; prereq_hint [vulnerable-user definition]; difficulty_hint 1; confusable_with [sec14-R01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0084]

FACT_ID: sec14-R03 | anchor: A03
A bicycle ridden when lights are needed must show a white front light plus red rear and side reflectors that remain visible from far down the road [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint bicycle-equipment; prereq_hint [night visibility]; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with [sec14-R12].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0086]

FACT_ID: sec14-R04 | anchor: A04
A driver meeting an emergency vehicle using sirens or flashing warning lights must promptly move to the right edge and halt until it goes by [A04].
Why it matters: group_hint emergency-yield; prereq_hint [right-of-way basics]; difficulty_hint 1; confusable_with [sec14-R05].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0087]

FACT_ID: sec14-R05 | anchor: A04
A driver coming upon a stopped roadside vehicle with flashing hazard lights must slow down, give generous room, and shift one lane away when it can be done safely [A04].
Why it matters: group_hint move-over; prereq_hint [sec14-R04]; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with [sec14-R04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0087]

FACT_ID: sec14-R06 | anchor: A06
A large truck hides vehicles directly ahead of its cab, along both sides near the cab, and far behind its trailer, so a car unseen in the truck mirror is unseen by the trucker [A06].
Why it matters: group_hint truck-blind-spots; prereq_hint [following distance]; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with [sec14-R01, sec14-R07].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0090]

FACT_ID: sec14-R07 | anchor: A06
A driver should never pull directly ahead of a fast-moving heavy truck because the loaded truck needs a much longer distance to halt than a car does [A06].
Why it matters: group_hint truck-following; prereq_hint [sec14-R06]; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with [sec14-R06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0090]

FACT_ID: sec14-R08 | anchor: A11
A stalled car on train tracks must be emptied at once, and anyone escaping an oncoming train should run angled toward the train so wreckage flies away from them [A11].
Why it matters: group_hint rail-emergency; prereq_hint [rail right-of-way]; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with [sec14-R09].
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0098]

FACT_ID: sec14-R09 | anchor: A10
A driver told to stop for a rail crossing must halt within a short marked band before the nearest rail and must stay stopped while the red lights keep flashing [A10].
Why it matters: group_hint rail-obedience; prereq_hint [traffic-control obedience]; difficulty_hint 1; confusable_with [sec14-R10].
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0096]

FACT_ID: sec14-R10 | anchor: A10
A driver must never steer around, beneath, or through rail gates while they are moving or lowered [A10].
Why it matters: group_hint rail-obedience; prereq_hint [sec14-R09]; difficulty_hint 1; confusable_with [sec14-R09].
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0096]

FACT_ID: sec14-R11 | anchor: A07
Slow filtering past stopped cars on a motorcycle is allowed only on suitable multilane roads at very low speed, while weaving between moving cars remains unlawful [A07].
Why it matters: group_hint motorcycle-lane-use; prereq_hint [lane discipline]; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with [sec14-R12].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0092]

FACT_ID: sec14-R12 | anchor: A08
A vehicle halted for a pedestrian must stay stopped until the walker has cleared at least the half of the roadway the driver occupies [A08].
Why it matters: group_hint pedestrian-yield; prereq_hint [crosswalk rules]; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with [sec14-R04].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0092]
